note: Apache County GIS server (maps.apachecountyaz.gov) publishes parcels, roads, districts, city boundaries, but no zoning district layer; its Hosted folder has no zoning service and Parcel_Main has no zoning field; the Utilities folder requires a token. The county zoning ordinance is a PDF only (community-development page). Eagar and St. Johns zoning is only a PDF map (eagaraz.gov) or unreadable storymap; Springerville GIS Map link has no URL. Parcel viewer jt.co.apache.az.us exposes no ArcGIS REST service.
